name: Unidentified snout-nosed species
description: This sentient species had long snouts and tusks, similar to a Pacithhip, although the tusks were much shorter and thicker. Behind the trunk and between the tusks was a heavily lipped mouth containing small square, white teeth. The back of their heads were crowned with a row of four spikes with a single row of spikes going down the back of their necks.
